name: Mage
role: Offensive magic, arcane utility, battlefield manipulation

baseSpellAttacks.note: All Mages begin knowing Magic Missile only. Force Bolt is optional, costs 10 Points to learn and never grants another Attack activation. Subclass starting Spell Attacks remain included as printed.

subclasses.name: Elementalist
subclasses.description: Elementalists manipulate the properties of their magic to produce powerful attacks, elemental effects, and area damage.

signatureAbility.name: Infusion
effect: During your own Assault activation, choose one Spell Attack you make as your chosen Assault action this activation. Apply one of the following modifications. Only one Infusion may be applied to an Attack.
Extend: Increase Range by +3". Ignore Cover.
Unleash: On Surge, choose one: Gain Direct Damage 1; or Gain Blast 1", or increase an existing Blast radius by 1".

subclassSpellAttacks.note: In addition to the Mage's Base Spell Attacks, pick one of the below.

subclasses.name: Necromancer
subclasses.description: Necromancers specialize in reanimation, attrition, and sustaining themselves through stolen vitality.

signatureAbility.name: Raise Thrall
effect: If you do not currently control a Thrall Unit, create one Engaged with this Necromancer containing min(Mind, 6) Models. A newly created Thrall Unit cannot activate during that Round. You control a maximum of one such Unit.

If you control a surviving Thrall Unit that is not Engaged with an enemy, restore up to TWO defeated Models to it, to a MAXIMUM of SIX Models. This may grow it beyond the original summoned number. Place models legally in Coherency, within 3" of an existing Thrall Model. A fully destroyed Thrall Unit cannot be reinforced; it can be summoned again on a later eligible use.
A Necromancer may control only one summoned Thrall Unit from Raise Thrall at a time. All other normal CP, timing, and reinforcement limitations remain in force.

subclassSpellAttacks.note: In addition to the Mage's Base Spell Attacks.

summonedUnit.name: Thrall

passive.name: Reanimated
passive.effect: At the end of the Round, if this Unit still contains at least one Model and lost Models during that Round, roll one D6 for each Model lost. For each natural 6, return one Model to the Unit following normal placement rules. A completely destroyed Thrall Unit cannot benefit from Reanimated. A Thrall Unit never exceeds six Models after any restoration.

derivedStats.hit: Necromancer Mysticism skill threshold +1 (6+ at Mysticism 5+ or 6+; 3+ at Mysticism 2+)
derivedStats.armor: Necromancer Medicine skill threshold +2, capped to range 2+...6+
derivedStats.evade: Necromancer Stealth skill threshold +3, capped to range 2+...6+
derivedStats.inheritedAnti: Inherit EVERY Anti-[tag] possessed by the Necromancer at rank max(0, rank-1). On a target with several matching tags, use only highest rank. Cannot inherit temporary one-Attack Command bonuses unless explicitly granted to Thralls.

notes: Printed 6+ Hit, Armor 6+, Evade 6+ are fallback minima for legacy tools; dynamically derive from Necromancer skills when resolving the Unit. Thralls remain W1, maximum six Models; Reanimated does not exceed six.

subclasses.name: Illusionist
subclasses.description: Illusionists manipulate perception, disrupt enemy attacks, and protect allies through deception.

signatureAbility.name: Phantasm
signatureAbility.effect: Summon one Phantasm token (32mm base) within Short of this Unit and at least 3" away from any enemy Units. The Illusion counts as a temporary friendly Unit for enemy movement, Charge declarations, and Attacks. Enemy Units declaring a Charge against a friendly Unit within 3" of the Illusion reduce their total Charge distance by X after rolling for Charge, where X is half of the Illusionist's Mind characteristic.

subclassSpellAttacks.note: In addition to the Mage's Base Spell Attacks.

combatPhaseOptionalSpell.name: Psychic Blade
combatPhaseOptionalSpell.note: Psychic Blade is optional and costs its printed 10 Points; the standard Dagger remains an equipment choice, not an additional free Attack.

optionalSpellAttacks.note: Optional permanently learned class Spell Attack; subject to normal spell-learning rules.
